title: Cities: Skylines II
provenance: Reported by teamusec-krause (highball-db#602, 2026-10-21), Apple M5 Max, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-crossover26.3-r27, DXMT environment, msync, rated 5 of 5 after 4 minutes. Not verified by the maintainer. Entropy-Xu (highball-db#1050, 2026-11-07), Apple M5 Max, macOS 27.2, Highball 0.10.23, engine x64-crossover26.3-r28, D3DMetal by the report (the environment's mode is DXMT), rated 4 of 5 after 19 minutes: with D3DM_MTL4=1 and AVX advertised, nothing stated about what wasn't perfect. jnp-nl (highball-db#1244, 2026-11-15), Apple M5 Max, macOS 27.2.1, Highball 0.10.23, engine x64-crossover26.3-r29, DXMT by the report (the environment's mode is D3DMetal), rated 5 of 5 after 201 minutes: Retina pixels at 100%, AVX advertised, a 60 fps cap. The in-game benchmark ran well. In the Paradox Launcher clicks land slightly below the pointer, so Play needs a click a little above the button, while the game itself has no offset.
notes: Reported perfect on the Wine 11 engine (x64-crossover26.3-r27) with DXMT on an M5 Max, after a short session of four minutes. No frame rate or city size was given and nothing was measured here. A second short report, on an M5 Max with the Wine 11 engine r28 (the D3DMetal 4 line) and D3DMetal by the report, rates it playable with minor issues, none named (highball-db#1050). Rated perfect over 201 minutes on an M5 Max with the Wine 11 engine r29, DXMT by the report, with good performance in the game's benchmark (highball-db#1244).

knownIssues.symptom: In the Paradox Launcher clicks land slightly below the pointer, so the Play button needs a click a little above it. The game itself has no offset (M5 Max, Wine 11 r29, Retina pixels at 100%, highball-db#1244)
knownIssues.fix: click a little above the button
